expenditures.detail: TRACED TO ONE ROW, +0.09. Four of the five Schedule B sheets close EXACTLY on their own printed subtotals: p3's 15 rows sum to 724.22, p4's 15 to 152.03, p6's 15 to 259.77 and p7's 2 to 47.19. Page 5's 15 rows sum to 216.56 against its printed subtotal of 216.47, so the whole discrepancy is on that sheet, and the side totals 1,399.77 against the printed 1,399.68 / Box D. THE OFFENDING ROW IS UNIQUELY IDENTIFIED, by the filer's own arithmetic and not by guesswork. This filer's mileage rows are computed as miles x $0.585 (he prints the rate in the very first one, 'Cottage Meeting - Cedar Fort, 48 miles x .585'), and EVERY other mileage cell on page 5 reproduces that formula to the cent: 20 mi -> 11.70 (three times), 10 -> 5.85, 66 -> 38.61, 19 -> 11.12, 6 -> 3.51, 40 -> 23.40, 44 -> 25.74, 12 -> 7.02, 50 -> 29.25, 9 -> 5.27. Only p5 row 13, 'Cottage Meeting - Orem, 15 mi.', breaks it: 15 x 0.585 = 8.775 -> 8.78, and the cell prints 8.87 — a transposition in the filer's own typing — while his page subtotal of 216.47 is the sum computed with 8.78. 216.56 - 216.47 = 0.09 = 8.87 - 8.78 exactly. WHAT WAS DONE: the cell was escalated to a 2000 dpi tight crop and it renders '8.87' UNAMBIGUOUSLY — this is a fillable-form typed figure, not a doubtful glyph, so the ADDENDUM I1 'let the arithmetic settle the digit' path does NOT apply and NOTHING WAS NUDGED. The row is retained verbatim at 8.87 and flagged. The whole p5 amount column was additionally re-rendered at 900 dpi and every one of the fifteen cells reproduced as recorded, and the doubled-band screen (ADDENDUM H3) passed on all five sheets — each measured band rendered exactly one figure — so the shortfall is not a missed or collapsed row. Correlated-error screen: the same filer's other filing in this chunk (4f4712bf, 4/1/2022) was transcribed independently and its own delta is a DIFFERENT figure with a different cause, so this is not a repeated identical error in the weber sense.
